title: Bring the shrinking day to the Guru
summary: Life is already diminishing; the Guru is where unfinished affairs are set right. Bring the unresolved day there before it disappears.
takeaway: Take the unfinished day to the Guru before time closes around it.
lifeApplication: Name the one matter you keep postponing, then place it before the Guru through ardas, honest repair, or the first obedient step.

source.shortMeaning: As life diminishes day and night, meeting the Guru is what sets the heart’s business right.
source.lifeApplication: Before another day disappears, take the unresolved thing to the Guru first.

evidence.coreClaim: As life diminishes day and night, meeting the Guru is what sets the heart’s business right.
evidence.turn: The shrinking day is not asking for panic; it is asking to be brought under the Guru’s care.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the one matter you keep postponing, then place it before the Guru through ardas, honest repair, or the first obedient step.
